reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Custom Headers: Kyverno Service API calls now also support custom headers", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional capability to send custom HTTP headers (e.g. Authorization) on Kyverno Service API calls; nothing existing is stated to break.

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a headers field to apiCall.service in context entries, so Service API calls can send custom HTTP headers; the same field appears in several policy and cleanup-policy CRDs, and ClusterPolicy is named here.
